name: Tiran
source:
Tiran (ティラン) is a dinosaur from the world of love and dreams who travels to Hinamizawa. He appears in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei in the Sanrio collaboration event It's Good To Have Friends...Right?.

[From 07th Expansion wikia]
